samples.summary: Design doc still asserts the CLI has no `templates` namespace — the premise of the seeding-commands section this change invalidates
samples.evidence: docs/design/template-gallery.md:983 reads "A new deployment's gallery is empty, and there is no way to fill it from outside a browser: publishing is JWT-only and the CLI has no `templates` namespace. Two operator commands close that…". After this change `wafflebase templates publish` exists (packages/cli/src/commands/templates.ts:117), so the stated justification for `pnpm backend seed:templates` / `register:templates` is now false. The doc is a top-level design doc, so the backtick-path CI lane touches it but cannot catch a stale claim. Fix belongs in the doc (or a note in the new CLI docs).

samples.summary: Published CLI reference (documentation package) not updated: `templates` missing from the namespace list, the alias table, and the per-namespace sections
samples.evidence: packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:155-190 enumerates every namespace (`docs`, `sheets`, `slides`, `notes`, `files`, `images`, `api-keys`) and the canonical→alias table (line 180 `| api-keys | api-key |`), and lines 194-1016 give one `## <namespace>` section each. The new `templates` (alias `template`) namespace appears in packages/cli/README.md:130 and docs/design/cli.md:405 but nowhere in this user-facing reference, so the shipped docs describe a command tree that no longer matches the binary. Note this doc already omits `folders`/`board`/`comments`, so it may be maintained selectively.

samples.summary: `templates list --scope workspace` / `templates use` silently drop an unset active workspace instead of failing locally, unlike every other namespace
samples.evidence: `getConfig(opts).workspace` is `''` when nobody has chosen a workspace (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:64-66 documents that `resolveConfig` returns `''` deliberately). `templateBrowseParams` drops empty values (packages/cli/src/client/url.ts:133), so the request goes out as `GET /templates?scope=workspace` with no `workspaceId`, which the backend answers with a 400 (`packages/backend/src/template/template.service.ts:1053-1057`); `templates use` sends `workspaceId: ''`, rejected by `UseTemplateDto` `@Length(1,200)` (packages/backend/src/template/template.dto.ts:283-285). Every other namespace builds its path through `workspaceSeg`, where the empty workspace at least cannot masquerade as a valid filter. Likely overlaps the correctness lens.

samples.summary: `templates.publish` schema advertises a `previewToken` field the CLI's own `TemplateListing` type does not declare
samples.evidence: registry.ts:1445 declares `response: { …, previewToken: 'string | null' }`, while `TemplateListing` in packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts:203-215 has no `previewToken` member (the frontend's equivalent type does — packages/frontend/src/api/templates.ts:60 omits it from a card, implying it exists on a listing). Payloads are relayed verbatim so runtime output is unaffected, but the two descriptions of the same response now disagree and will drift.
